title: Dictionary entry
description: One record in data/languages/<iso3>/dictionary/<a-z>.yaml. Field names and shape from SPEC.md §3.2. Not a schema for the archive line itself; see docs/unl-reference/formats/dictionary.md for that.

headword.description: The natural-language word (archive NLW field), without the [brackets].

id.description: The entry's primary key (archive ID field). One NLW may hold several IDs, one per sense.

uw.description: The Universal Word (archive UW field), a UCL string or a UCN numeric code, kept exactly as the archive writes it. Empty-UW entries (e.g. punctuation) are out of scope for this schema's minLength; revisit if one is imported.

features.description: The feature list (archive FEATURE LIST field) as attribute-value pairs, e.g. LEX, POS, LST, PAR, FRA. Values come from tagset.yaml; this schema does not itself check tagset membership (tools/validate does).

lang.description: Archive: two-letter (FLG, e.g. af, en). The importer translates to iso3 for the store folder name; whether this field itself is rewritten to iso3 is open, see docs/factory/store-schema.md.

frequency.description: Archive FRE field. Used for analysis: which NL word to prefer for a surface form.

priority.description: Archive PRI field. Used for generation: which NL word to prefer for a UW.

archive_path.description: Path under data/archive/ the record was read from.

line.description: Line number in archive_path, or a descriptive locator (e.g. a paradigm or frame catalogue number) when the archive export has no per-line grain.
